scope: Mechanical retention of two explicitly authorized frozen preparation/review packets only. Scientific verdicts and reviewer independence remain in each byte-exact packet; this retention is not a new acceptance.

baseline.qualification: The source packets retain their own baseline bindings unchanged; no new baseline or maintained-state acceptance is made by retention.

portable_paths: Archive and member paths are relative; source_owner_basename identifies provenance, not an extraction destination or required absolute path.

format.member_order: lexicographically sorted per packet; consecutive split parts
format.partition_method: Conservative payload padded to512 plus4096 bytes per member; no member split or omission.

limits: Every physical source-owner file included, including manifest/freeze, failures and hidden/ignored files.
Nested containers are retained and hashed as opaque outer file payloads; their contents are not decoded or newly scientifically reviewed.
Active canonical/scientific/integration review and root CI are excluded; only the two pinned frozen packets are included.
This index carries no new scientific verdict, global discovery/exhaustion claim or issue closure.
